document_strings: I was there for 6 months in 1940 and enlisted until 1940-1941. I was drafted in the Army. Before that I had my ant with the Bobby Dodson - After being discharged in 1943 I was out being a bar bell player - The FIRST JOB held in 1943 was for G M Bulson selling pretty may goods and also selling electri-TSII for the Knoll Electric Fanning Co. The net for I have was selling shirts for Mr Sepp and selling cutisy other broilees Lake 3-11th st selling shirts also Scott FIFTH ave - Then I got a job working for the pendulum DEPT - for vise The next held had was as conductor for the FRT D. Berry which lasted for about 3 years 1952 - 1956 Then I got a job in the DARK Dept - N. Fe from May 16 - 1956 Ann 1953 when I had 2 H - IN T ATTACK - Then I retired 27 years
